summary: The MaintGoverningOrg system manages governing organizations, allowing for the creation, update, and deletion of organization entries.
purpose: To handle CRUD operations for governing organizations within the system.

entities.name: GoverningOrg
entities.description: An entity representing a governing organization with attributes like name, address, and contact details.

actors.name: System Administrator
actors.description: A user with permissions to edit governing organization details.

workflows.name: Manage Governing Organizations
steps: Add, edit or delete an organization using the interface.
Enter details such as Name, Address, and contact information.
Save the changes to update the system records.

business_rules: An organization cannot be deleted if it is referenced elsewhere.
conditions: Check if the screen is editable to enable certain controls.
system_behavior: Grid controls handle row commands for adding, editing, or deleting entries.

dependencies.name: UserSession
dependencies.description: Session details provide context for operations like use of phone mask.

exceptions: Cannot delete an organization if constraints are violated.
